name: which-one-guide
title: Which one guide
description: If you are this, pick that: scenario rows that point each kind of buyer to the right plan, model or product.
docs: Pass rows (a scenario in the reader's own voice and the recommendation: a name, a one-line reason and a link) and, optionally, a fallback for the reader nobody wrote a sentence for. A row reads scenario, arrow, then the option as a chip with its reason; on a medium block it is two columns, the scenario beside the answer, with the arrow leading into the chip; on a narrow block the arrow turns downward and the answer sits under the scenario. The chip names the option in words and screen readers hear Recommended before it. It is a static decision aid with no quiz and no state, so it renders on the server and works with JavaScript off. Words are translated through labels.
